povs.reachability_notes: REPORTABLE — but OUR PoV UNDER-DEMONSTRATES IT and would be rejected as filed. ENTRY POINT is public and UNAUTHENTICATED: WikiServlet is mapped to /wiki/* and the container security-constraints are commented out by default ('REMOVE ME TO ENABLE CONTAINER-MANAGED AUTH'). Chain at HEAD: GET /wiki/View?do=... -> WikiServlet.doGet:85 -> getForwardPage:93 -> ShortURLConstructor.getForwardPage:159 returns getParameter('do')+'.jsp' -> getRequestDispatcher:94 -> forward:97. BOUNDARY crossed: forward() reaches /WEB-INF/*, which a direct HTTP request cannot. PRECONDITION: jspwiki.urlConstructor=ShortURLConstructor — non-default but documented and supported. *** THE POV DEFECT: getForwardPage appends '.jsp' UNCONDITIONALLY, so the shipped payload do=WEB-INF/userdatabase resolves to /WEB-INF/userdatabase.jsp, which does not exist and 404s in a real container. CAVEAT: the '?'-split step is derived from standard Tomcat/Jetty behaviour, not re-run in a live container — do that before filing.

There is no framework-driven HTTP->sink chain: the only production caller in Apache is HTL's XSSRuntimeExtension.java:121 (case STYLE_TOKEN -> getValidStyleToken), reached ONLY when a template author writes @ context='styleToken'.
